Breitling Navitimer B09 Chronograph 41 (AB0950211B1A1) or Omega Speedmaster Moonwatch Professional 42 (310.30.42.50.01.001)? $8,400 vs $7,800.

Both are steel chronographs in the same price band. Breitling: $8,400 at Betteridge. Omega: $7,800 retail at The 1916 Company and CD Peacock. Prices dated 22 November 2026; dealer prices vary, so check before you buy.

Which would you rather wear: the Navitimer or the Moonwatch?
